about: Reviewed differences between Creeds.json's WCF and its witnesses: the 1649 printing (EEBO-TCP A80320) and andrewhwaller/westminster-json (provenance/registry.json). 'corrections' are applied at ingest: 'text' replaces words in a section (each 'from' must occur exactly once), 'proofs' replaces references in a footnote. 'accepted' are differences checked and found benign; our reading stands. Modernised spelling (honor, forever) is kept as an editorial choice. Maintained with npm run review; see res/SOURCES.md.
